title: Multi-dealer RFQ — concurrent fan-out + ranked best-bid/offer panel
description: The multi-dealer RFQ capability: MultiDealerEngine fans an RfqRequest out to every registered QuoteSource concurrently, ranks the responses into a best-bid/offer panel with deterministic tie-break, and exposes the winning dealer for click-to-trade. This is the frozen-contract acceptance for the deliverable 'rfq-multidealer'.

assertions.statement: MultiDealerEngine::request is the single fan-out entry point that accepts an RfqRequest and returns a ranked panel.
QuoteSource::request is the per-dealer seam every liquidity provider (FixLpAdapter, InternalPricerSource) implements, so a new LP plugs in without touching the engine.
SideKey::partial_cmp_total provides the total order used to rank quotes into the best-bid/offer panel with a deterministic tie-break.
